exclusions.name: Mayoral veto or other procedural hurdles
exclusions.why_safe: The village charter (e3) only requires three affirmative votes for adoption; no veto or additional approval is mentioned. Excluding such hurdles is safe because the evidence does not indicate any.

exclusions.name: Other council members or alternates
exclusions.why_safe: The council has exactly five members per e1; no alternates or substitutes are mentioned in the evidence. Excluding others is safe because the charter and rules define the voting body as these five.

exclusions.name: Postponement by someone other than sponsor
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules state only the sponsor can move postponement (e11). Excluding others is safe because they lack authority to postpone.

exclusions.name: Remote or proxy voting
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules require physical presence to vote (e4), and no remote participation is allowed. Excluding remote voting is safe because it is not permitted.
